Agents, skills and teams

Start with the job
you need done.

Install an agent for a specific job or a team with several roles. Each is a versioned package, with the skills it needs included.

01 / Agent
✦

Agents take on a role.

An agent’s package defines its role, instructions, tool hints and compatible models. Choose the agent for the job you have in mind.

Role and instructions
02 / Skill

Skills explain how to do it.

A skill is a reusable procedure in SKILL.md. It can include scripts and references, and different agents can use it.

Procedures, scripts and references
03 / Team

Teams bring the roles together.

Hire a named team to install its members in one go. Each agent’s role is passed to your coding tool for delegation.

Multiple agents with defined roles
Choose a package and a version.@namespace/name@version
Claude Code, Cursor and Gemini CLI

Use the same agent
across your tools.

You shouldn’t have to translate an agent every time you switch tools. Crewd writes Claude Code agent files, Cursor rules and GEMINI.md sections from the same package.

Team roles go into the tool’s own delegation descriptions, so there’s no extra orchestrator to set up.

For teams sharing a repo

Give every teammate
the same setup.

You’ve found a crew that works. Commit the manifest and lockfile so the rest of your team can install exactly what you’re using.

01

Pick an agent or team.

Run crewd hire for an agent or crewd hire team for a team. Crewd resolves the skills they depend on.

crewd hire team @acme/backend-squad
Example: 4 agents and 6 skills
02

Commit the two files.

crewd.json records your setup. crewd.lock pins package versions and hashes. Commit both with the code.

{ }crewd.jsonManifest
#crewd.lockVersions + SHA-256
03

Your team runs one command.

crewd install installs the same crew from the lockfile. Teammates can skip moving folders around or comparing agent files by hand.

crewd install✓
The same versions and hashes

Questions about Crewd

Before you
install.

How installation, upgrades and access work.

What happens when I hire an agent?

Crewd downloads the package, resolves its skills and writes the native files for your coding tools. It records the package version and SHA-256 hash in crewd.lock.

Which tools does it support?

Claude Code, Cursor and Gemini CLI. Crewd compiles the same package into each tool’s native format.

How do agents in a team work together?

Crewd installs each member and compiles its role into your coding tool’s delegation descriptions. The tool handles delegation; there’s no separate Crewd orchestrator.

Will upgrades remove my custom skills?

Skills you add with crewd teach stay attached when you upgrade the package. Those additions belong to this repository.

Can I try it now?

Crewd is in private beta. Join the waitlist to request early access. The package names and CLI walkthroughs here are product examples.
